svg.title: SEARCH/REPLACE blocks are verified against the file, then emitted as a unified diff
svg.desc: Flowchart in two stages. Agent loop: the agent calls tools (read_*), then verifies old_lines. If verification is AMBIGUOUS, it fixes old_lines and loops back to the tools step. If OK, it submits the review: comments and patches. Post loop: each patch goes through a patch verification gate. If it passes (OK), hutch emits a unified diff and renders it in the UI. If it fails (FAIL), the patch is downgraded to a plain comment, which is also rendered in the UI.
